editions.editorsBrief: Today the Banco Master case stopped moving fast and started moving seriously. The plenary slipped to late September, but the five-day clocks keep running: the PGR owes two opinions, the plenary owes a decision on whether Moraes himself faces an inquiry, and the dossier gained its most important correction — the R$131M figure everyone repeated is not in the police report.

leadStory.headline: The banker, the justice, and 52 messages: inside the case testing Brazil's Supreme Court
leadStory.deck: A 218-page police forensic report, a family law firm's contract, and a fight over who broke the rules first — what the Banco Master file actually proves, and what it doesn't.

stories.headline: Fachin postpones plenary — the STF buys itself a week
stories.label: CONFIRMED
stories.text: The public session on the PF report moves to the second half of September, but the five-day manifestation clocks keep running for Moraes, Mendonça, the PGR and the PF director-general.

stories.headline: The R$131M figure that isn't in the report
stories.label: PRIMARY DOCUMENT
stories.text: The 218-page PF analysis documents R$3M/month, R$3,422,268.14, R$22,815,120.95 and an aircraft donation. The R$131M total repeated in Congress exists only as press aggregation.

stories.headline: Denial watch: what Moraes's March note did — and didn't — say
stories.label: CORROBORATED
stories.text: The 6 March denial addressed the CPMI-INSS dataset, not this extraction. His office has not repeated it since unsealing. Both 'he lied' and 'the denial stands' outrun the record.

stories.headline: PGR manifestação lands on the case file
stories.label: PRIMARY DOCUMENT
stories.text: The Attorney-General's office filed its position on Pet 16662 — the document is public and in our evidence library.
